create_peoples_speech_dataset: create a PeoplesSpeech dataset from ML Commons People's Speech audio data with a specified processor
test_dataset_template: test the PeoplesSpeech dataset_template method to format audio examples for Qwen2AudioProcessor or WhisperProcessor
refactor_filter_tokenizer_args: refactor the filter_tokenizer_args method to remove non-tokenizer columns for WhisperProcessor datasets
review_tokenize_method: review the tokenize method that processes audio data with WhisperProcessor or falls back to parent tokenize
summarize_peoples_speech_class: summarize the PeoplesSpeech class for loading and preprocessing audio datasets with Whisper or Qwen2Audio models
